name: Estavel Hall 34 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Deck Area: Spacious deck measuring 826 square metres, providing ample room for various activities and equipment setup. Optimal Freeboard Height: 24-centimetre freeboard ensures safety and stability by reducing water ingress and enhancing deck dryness. Capacity: Designed to accommodate up to 27 people comfortably, making it suitable for group operations or gatherings. Mooring Depth: Engineered for secure mooring at depths up to 60 metres, supporting a wide range of deployment locations, including deep-water environments. Station Keeping: Equipped with a fixed mooring system for reliable station keeping, ensuring the deck remains securely positioned during use. Standardized Measurements: All specifications are provided according to industry-standard six-axis criteria for easy comparison and compliance. Main Benefits Versatile Usage: The expansive deck area allows for flexible use, whether for work, leisure, or equipment storage, meeting diverse operational needs. Enhanced Safety: The 24 cm freeboard improves safety by minimizing the risk of water washing over the deck, addressing common user concerns about wet conditions and stability. Group Accommodation: With a 27-person occupancy, this deck is ideal for team-based tasks, events, or crew activities, supporting efficient workflows and social functions. Deep-Water Compatibility: The 60-metre mooring depth makes this deck suitable for offshore or deep-water applications, answering user queries about deployment versatility. Reliable Positioning: The fixed mooring system ensures the deck remains stable and secure, providing peace of mind for users who require consistent station keeping. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Marine Operations: Perfect for offshore platforms, floating workspaces, or research stations needing a stable, spacious, and secure deck. Event Hosting: Suitable for hosting gatherings, meetings, or training sessions on the water, thanks to its generous capacity and safety features. Equipment Storage and Deployment: The large deck area supports the storage and handling of equipment for marine construction, maintenance, or scientific research. Long-Term Deployment: Designed for durability and secure mooring, making it an excellent choice for extended use in challenging marine environments. Frequently Asked Questions Is the deck easy to maintain? Yes, the robust construction and standardized measurements ensure straightforward maintenance and compatibility with common marine equipment. Is it suitable for rough water? The 24 cm freeboard and fixed mooring system provide stability and safety even in variable water conditions. Can it be used for both commercial and recreational purposes? Absolutely, the versatile design supports a wide range of professional and leisure activities.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Deck Area: Spacious deck measuring 826 square metres, providing ample room for various activities and equipment setup.
  • Optimal Freeboard Height: 24-centimetre freeboard ensures safety and stability by reducing water ingress and enhancing deck dryness.
  • Capacity: Designed to accommodate up to 27 people comfortably, making it suitable for group operations or gatherings.
  • Mooring Depth: Engineered for secure mooring at depths up to 60 metres, supporting a wide range of deployment locations, including deep-water environments.
  • Station Keeping: Equipped with a fixed mooring system for reliable station keeping, ensuring the deck remains securely positioned during use.
  • Standardized Measurements: All specifications are provided according to industry-standard six-axis criteria for easy comparison and compliance.

Main Benefits

  • Versatile Usage: The expansive deck area allows for flexible use, whether for work, leisure, or equipment storage, meeting diverse operational needs.
  • Enhanced Safety: The 24 cm freeboard improves safety by minimizing the risk of water washing over the deck, addressing common user concerns about wet conditions and stability.
  • Group Accommodation: With a 27-person occupancy, this deck is ideal for team-based tasks, events, or crew activities, supporting efficient workflows and social functions.
  • Deep-Water Compatibility: The 60-metre mooring depth makes this deck suitable for offshore or deep-water applications, answering user queries about deployment versatility.
  • Reliable Positioning: The fixed mooring system ensures the deck remains stable and secure, providing peace of mind for users who require consistent station keeping.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Marine Operations: Perfect for offshore platforms, floating workspaces, or research stations needing a stable, spacious, and secure deck.
  • Event Hosting: Suitable for hosting gatherings, meetings, or training sessions on the water, thanks to its generous capacity and safety features.
  • Equipment Storage and Deployment: The large deck area supports the storage and handling of equipment for marine construction, maintenance, or scientific research.
  • Long-Term Deployment: Designed for durability and secure mooring, making it an excellent choice for extended use in challenging marine environments.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the deck easy to maintain? Yes, the robust construction and standardized measurements ensure straightforward maintenance and compatibility with common marine equipment.
  • Is it suitable for rough water? The 24 cm freeboard and fixed mooring system provide stability and safety even in variable water conditions.
  • Can it be used for both commercial and recreational purposes? Absolutely, the versatile design supports a wide range of professional and leisure activities.
